title: August 2026 fresh-intake production - batch G3 (twelve of the thirteen adjudicated asks; AUG-0015 held on governance)
note: Third fresh-intake batch, authorised by the same per-occurrence adjudication record as G1 and G2, and frozen ask-by-ask in AUGUST2026_BATCH_G3_FREEZE.json before any answer was written. Eleven new cards and one enrichment. TWO DECISIONS CHANGED ON READING THE LIVE CARD rather than searching it, and both are recorded. AUG-0003 was adjudicated GENUINE_NEW_QUESTION, but QB8_A#q7 already carried a correct section on the secondary means of venting under SOLAS II-2/11.6.3.2; only the PAIR was missing, so it became an enrichment. AUG-0015 was expected to be held for being too broad; it is not too broad - MSC.550(108) and MSC.555(108) were verified - but it is held anyway, because its only natural home, QB2_F#q3, currently attributes those requirements to MSC.532(107). Producing there would have made one card contradict itself, and producing beside it would have put a right answer next to a wrong one on the same page. That defect is OPEN-G1-010 and it must be corrected before AUG-0015 is produced. EXAMINER ATTRIBUTION: no card in this batch names an examiner. AUG-0086 and AUG-0087 carry an individual attribution to Senthil in the intake store, but the examiner index derives from its own governed evidence ledger, and writing a relationship in through card markup would bypass it. Relationships stay at 958. CURRENCY: every regulatory claim is stated as at August 2026. The emergency towing figures were read from the text of MSC.35(63) rather than recalled, and the Hong Kong Convention is written as in force.

cards.topic: A vessel carrying weapons anchored beyond 24 nautical miles - the zone question underneath it, flag-State jurisdiction under UNCLOS Art 92, and the SUA 2005 Protocol boarding regime
Defective oily water separator two days before arrival - the SINGLE first action, and why it is stop and retain rather than repair or report
Chemical or oil-product tanker against a traditional crude carrier - one dirty cargo in bulk versus many clean cargoes kept apart, and everything that follows from it
Emergency towing arrangements - the 15 minute and 1 hour deployment times, the two limbs of SOLAS II-1/3-4, and the strengths
Why the EU Ship Recycling Regulation survives the Hong Kong Convention's entry into force - the European List, wider hazardous-materials scope, and directly applicable enforcement
ALARP - the gross disproportion test, and the examiner's second limb: why risk is reduced rather than eliminated
The fire tetrahedron - the fourth face, and the mapping of every shipboard medium onto the face it attacks
The instrument set for an LPG carrier in three layers - base set, gas-specific overlay, and HNS rather than CLC for the liability limb
Delegating a job to the 2/E or 3/E - four instruments answering four different questions, and the accountability that does not transfer
The margin line - the 76 mm definition, the deterministic regime it governs, and the probabilistic method that replaced it for ships built from 1 January 2009
Pumping water overboard from a cargo hold - no direct route, and the contamination question that decides whether it may be discharged at all
Primary and secondary means of venting as a matched pair - the limb the card did not carry, added without restating the hardware chain it already owns

held_actions.blocker: AUG-0015 is answerable and was verified: the latest ro-ro package as at August 2026 is Res. MSC.550(108) amending SOLAS II-2/20, with FSS Code amendments in Res. MSC.555(108), in force 1 January 2026, applying to cargo ships and ro-ro passenger ships constructed on or after that date, with retroactive requirements on existing passenger ships by the first survey on or after 1 January 2028. It is held because there is nowhere safe to publish it. Its only natural home, QB2_F#q3, currently credits those same ro-ro detection and cargo-control-room requirements to MSC.532(107) -- which is the PFOS, lifting appliance, inclinometer and Polar package. Enriching that card would leave one card asserting two different resolutions for one requirement; opening a second card in the same file would put a correct answer beside a wrong one on a single paid page, which is worse for a candidate than the cross-file disagreement with QB10_B#q1 that exists today. Correcting published candidate-facing regulatory text needs a correction manifest and a digest pin, which batch G3 is not authorised to make.
held_actions.not_this: NOT held for lack of evidence, and NOT held as too broad -- which is what the intake record and the session brief both anticipated. The scope resolved cleanly against primary sources. The hold is purely about the destination.
held_actions.unblocks_when: OPEN-G1-010 is sized and landed as a correction. Once QB2_F#q3 names MSC.550(108), AUG-0015 can be produced there as an enrichment with no contradiction.
